scenario.summary: Guest adds a second simple product that has a personalizable AdditionalInformation attribute, types a personalization text and verifies the '<label> : <text>' line on that product's cart row.
steps: Search the personalizable SKU and open it
Add to Cart and open the cart
Find the cart row by product name and verify '<label> : <text>'
stateChanges: Guest cart: a second simple product with personalization is added
assertions: The product's cart row shows 'AdditionalInformation : <typed text>'
evidence: Independent method (priority 25, no dependsOn) with its own record; it runs after the navigation chain's head, so the cart also holds that product and the row is found by product name.

The personalization input locator is fixed to txtProductPersonalizationAdditionalinformation, so the need pins personalizationAttribute AdditionalInformation. New key PRODUCT_SIMPLE_PERSONALIZABLE_IN_STOCK with a drafted query (pending; outputs sku, name, productId, retailPrice, salesPrice, price, personalizationCode).
PersonalizeLabel2 -> product.personalizationCode (equals the pinned code). The typed text (also 'AdditionalInformation' in the sheet) is chosen by the test: config.
Distinct records: the chain head's product is another method's need (PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK); the sheet uses different SKUs (z-2420004, z-2410001).
Profile (Playwright observations): z-2410001 is an active SimpleProduct (BlackAndDecker) in PRODUCTION, inventory 250, required add-ons 0.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
